payload.title: The FCR tab computes a third, client-side FCR from stale snapshots that disagrees with the backend FCR authority once a weighing, a mortality, a cull or a transfer exists
payload.rule_violated: One FCR SSoT: the backend authority serves the per-batch FCR and the client renders it, it does not recompute it
payload.notes: Found by the 2026-10-26 Feeding production E2E audit (report: docs/reviews/claude/2026-10-27-feeding-audit-report.md).
narrative: Live recompute: displayed biomass is the stored snapshot (250 / 240 / 250 kg) while the live derived biomass is 245.75 / 237.36 / 250 kg. Today every batch reads 'No Data' (no weighing exists). Fix: serve the cumulative FCR from the backend in the batch list and delete the client formula.
